mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair risperidone metabolism and increase CNS/cardiac adverse effects; both drugs prolong QT interval independently.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and QTc interval closely; maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure potassium and magnesium supplementation.
